description: Configure the controller to look members up by a custom attribute instead of the default id-based lookup, and exercise that lookup across additional member-scoped actions and under a differently named lookup attribute. Member-scoped actions resolve the record through the configured attribute, which is visible in the data-store interaction reported in the transcript.

cases.expected_output:
store=find_by slug=forty-two
assign=article
status=200
body=Edit HTML

store=find_by code=abc-123
assign=article
status=200
body=Show HTML

store=find_by slug=forty-two
store=destroy ok=true
assign=article
status=302
redirect=http://test.host/articles
flash.notice=Article was successfully destroyed.
